# ui::TrayFlyoutOptions

Header: `winui/ui/TrayIcon.hpp`.

What [tray_flyout_options()](namespace-ui.md#tray_flyout_options) takes: the few things an app chooses about a tray flyout.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The window's title. No caption shows it, but screen readers read it. |
| `width` | `float` | `360.0f` | The flyout's client width, in DIPs. Its height follows its content. |
| `shadow` | `bool` | `false` | A drop shadow under the flyout. Off by default, as under the system's own flyouts. The rounded corners and the 1px rim stay either way. |
| `theme` | `ThemeRequest` |  | What to resolve the flyout's [Theme](../themes/theme.md) from. |
| `backdrop` | `Backdrop` | `Backdrop::None` | A system backdrop behind the flyout instead of its fill. Off by default. |
| `spell_check` | `SpellCheckOptions` |  | See [SpellCheckOptions](spell-check-options.md). |
